exclusions.reason: These records were visible in a public schema preview before protocol freeze.
exclusions.post_freeze_exclusions: none; malformed, missing, or corrupt required data fails preparation instead of being silently skipped

grouping_and_split.group_id: falcongrp- plus first 16 hex characters of SHA256(canonical JSON group payload)
grouping_and_split.split_algorithm: sort unique groups by SHA256(split_seed_text + '|' + group_id), then assign the first floor(0.40 * group_count) groups to adaptation and all remaining groups to confirmation

primary_soft_adaptation.features: three calibrated unsafe-probability logits in frozen judge order

mechanism_control_hard_adaptation.features: three binary judge decisions at native 0.5 score thresholds in frozen judge order

prespecified_models.zero_shot_stress_test: MMDS-frozen calibrators, stacker, and threshold without Falcon refitting

claims_and_endpoints.primary_metric: macro_f1 on the untouched confirmation partition

primary_claims.comparison: primary_soft_adaptation minus same-pool two-of-three hard majority
primary_claims.support_rule: point estimate greater than zero and Holm-adjusted one-sided paired group-randomization p below 0.05
primary_claims.strong_support_rule: the paired group-bootstrap 95% confidence interval lower bound is greater than zero

primary_claims.comparison: primary_soft_adaptation minus prespecified hard-label logistic adaptation
primary_claims.support_rule: point estimate greater than zero and Holm-adjusted one-sided paired group-randomization p below 0.05
primary_claims.strong_support_rule: the paired group-bootstrap 95% confidence interval lower bound is greater than zero

claims_and_endpoints.multiplicity: Holm correction across FALCON-C1 and FALCON-C2

reporting_contract.category_analysis: descriptive only; no category-specific fitting or selection
prohibited_after_freeze: changing C, solver, class weighting, or threshold
excluding samples based on labels or model outputs
reopening confirmation labels for model revision
